title: GCP VPC Basics: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Think of a university campus. One campus, many buildings, in different cities. That's a Google Cloud V P C.

scenes.heading: The campus
scenes.narration: Google's V P C works differently from Amazon's. A V P C is global, and can span regions. Subnets are regional, and cover every zone in the region. Firewall rules are stateful. Rules match tags or service accounts, not just addresses.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It's global in Google Cloud. Subnets are regional. The firewall is stateful.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva GCP VPC lab
